mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises >0.2pp monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline indicate strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS rise and UNRATE fall fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances over 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, declining HOUST signals weakening housing demand and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when HOUST declines during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO indicates robust industrial output and economic growth, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 for INDPRO predicting 5-day SPX returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS falling below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing borrowing costs and stimulating equity valuations to produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS falls below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes, declining UNRATE indicates labor market improvement, boosting consumer confidence and spending to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when UNRATE declines during high unemployment regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDPC1 growth acceleration and RSAFS expansion indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Joint GDPC1 acceleration and RSAFS growth fail to produce positive 60-day returns in >60% of instances over 5-year rolling window.
